titulo: Igualdade Tomita na Fock concreta e peso dual; rito integral iniciado
resultado: On the same canonical Fock, the closed Tomita graph of the concrete Weyl algebra and vacuum equals the exponential Tomita graph. Domains and actions agree. Independent recompilation and the real graph-closure proof were reviewed by separate hands. The actual dual weight on the same Fock regular core is additive, homogeneous, monotone and dual-invariant; its value at the unit is infinite. It is not the scaled trace. Nine core/embedding/action fields are supplied by terms, with 26 remaining fields explicit and no full inhabitant asserted.
defeito: Polar/KMS, traco escalado, rede/materia conjuntos e encerramento do rito ainda pendentes.
proximo_passo: Pagar autoadjuncao do lift exponencial e ligacao modular/trace; conferir main integral.
